info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Shippings-v2-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Shipping Retrieval API allows businesses to fetch shipping options and details for items in their customers' ecommerce carts. This API provides essential shipping information based on the contents of the cart, helping users make informed decisions during the checkout process. Typical consumers of this API include online retailers and integration partners aiming to enhance the shopping experience by offering real-time shipping solutions. Use this endpoint to streamline the shipping selection process and improve customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve shipping options for the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch available shipping methods and rates for items currently in the shopping cart. It provides essential information for users to choose their preferred shipping option before checkout.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the shipping details associated with the cart. This may include the user's shipping preferences and any required information to calculate shipping costs.

ListEcommerceCartShippingsRequest.description: A placeholder for the request body of the GET operation related to shipping details in the shopping cart.

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the shipping request.

resultId.description: An identifier representing the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipping process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message regarding the status of the request.

ListEcommerceCartShippingsResponse_201.description: Response schema for the successful retrieval of shipping information related to a cart.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the processing of the request.
